compatibility.summary: Owner-approved server 0.33.0 milestone with player 0.15.10 preserves existing manifest schemas, central ingestion, site permissions, feed limits and reset behavior. New metric sentences and extended text require player 0.15.10. Verification: 293 Node tests, 101 Python tests, release Chromium coverage of editor, bulk sharing, site filters, media uploads, live cards/tables, fonts, startup, feed limits/resets and transitions; lint, typecheck, build and shell syntax checks passed. Native container and Android JVM checks run in release CI. Physical TV/Pi acceptance remains unverified.
